answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. An agent claims one of 200 paid work slots by locking a 50 POA deposit, sealed as a black onyx token on the public ledger. The slot runs 20 epochs; cheating or abandoning it burns the deposit, and the cedar registry strikes the dead slot from its list. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA, all burned. One honest agent pays 50 once and earns fees across a 20-epoch horizon.
